scope: Compact-only Hugging Face Kraken order-book recap expansion and chronological LambdaRank spread-target ablation

source.futures_status: No futures order-book tree exists in this source; every row is explicitly marked spot_fallback_no_futures_in_abraxasccs_dataset.

retention.raw_book_payloads: streamed in process memory and discarded after L2 recap

target_contract.absolute_future_spread: literal future full spread in bps
target_contract.spread_delta: future spread minus current spread, normalized by strictly-prior per-symbol robust spread MAD scale
target_contract.asset_relative_deviation: future spread minus strictly-prior per-symbol median, normalized by the same scale

implementation.cross_profile_normalization: strictly-prior per-symbol spread baseline plus bid/ask displayed depth ratios at 10, 50, and 100 bps; no trade volume is present in the compact order-book-only contract

promotion_status: research-only; the ranker has not been wired into live admission or execution.
